thread:
Lina: Heads-up — planning to onboard verdigris-4b (4B, float16) into the model-catalog tomorrow. Need a pin + canary rollout. Proposing quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Who can own deploy + smoke? cc @Kai @Tom

Kai: I can own the deploy. Plan: start canary at 02:05 UTC, run canary for ~15m, then alias swap if smoke looks good. I'll create a rollback tag ahead of time. :rocket:

Tom: I'll run smoke tests and watch infra. Preparing a smoke script now. @Riley can you be on pager for the window? deploy-bot, please reserve a slot.

Riley: Onpager 02:00-04:30 UTC. Trigger me if latency > 1500ms or error rate > 2%. If anything smells off I'll request immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Reserved slot for verdigris-4b: SLOT-8243 (team:redwood-eng) from 02:00-04:30 UTC. To kick off canary, run:
```
# start canary deploy + smoke
rdwctl deploy --model verdigris-4b --mode canary --slot SLOT-8243
rdwctl smoke --slot SLOT-8243 --checks latency,error,throughput
```

Tom: Smoke script pushed to repo and CI. Quick snippet for the smoke run:
`curl -s https://smoke-api.internal/run?model=verdigris-4b | jq .summary`
If summary.latency_p50 > 800ms or summary.error_rate > 0.02 -> fail.

Kai: I'll pin the model metadata + quant profile before 02:00. Quant profile: q4_8 recommended for this workload. Manifest and weights already in staging registry. :white_check_mark:

Lina: Preflight checklist (quick):
- manifest uploaded to staging-registry (kai)
- quant profile set to q4_8 (kai)
- eval set pass >95% (tom)
- smoke script in CI (tom)
- rollback tag created (kai)
- slot reserved (deploy-bot)

Kai: Creating rollback tag now -> `revert-verdigris-2026-03-17`. Will ping here when done.

Tom: If smoke passes by 02:20 I'll request flip at 02:25 and monitor 30m post-swap. If any regression, rollback to `revert-verdigris-2026-03-17`.

Riley: Acknowledged. I'll watch dashboards (latency, token-per-second, failure-rate) and be ready to mute traffic to canary if needed. Ping with `@Riley` in thread to escalate.

Lina: Great — thanks all. I'll post a short runbook in the thread 30m before start with final timings. :slightly_smiling_face:
